text.p: The initial public offering of AMERISAFE Inc has been withdrawn due to market conditions, lead underwriter for the deal, Smith Barney, said Friday.
A syndicate representative at Smith Barney said Friday that the number of shares being offered was revised Thursday to 10 million from 11 million and that the IPO was expected to price at $9 a share.
A regulatory filing earlier in the week said that the pricing range had been cut to $10 to $12 a share from a prior estimate of $13 to $15 a share.
The Louisiana-based provider of managed care workers' compensation products to employees in high risk occupations was expected to make its market debut Friday, Smith Barney said.
